metadata.title: Tesla Stock Rises. Inside the EV Maker's Shanghai Gigafactory. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Inside Tesla’s Shanghai Gigafactory and What It Means for the Stock.
Tesla’s “Giga Factory” in Shanghai is its largest and most productive plant, making Model 3s, Ys, and stationary power storage products. Most investors likely haven’t been inside. Barclays analyst Dan Levy has.
